name: Graveyard & Mausoleum
description: Leaning headstones, iron railings and a cracked mausoleum in wet grass.
palette: lichen-grey stone, wet grass green, rusted iron, fog white
lighting: flat overcast twilight, ground mist, cold and shadowless
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: wet tussocky grass between sunken grave plots, gravel paths worn through it
materials: A fantasy graveyard seen from above. Rows of leaning weathered headstones and flat table tombs, none of them carrying any lettering, sunken grave plots in wet tussocky grass, gravel paths worn between them, a cracked stone mausoleum with its door ajar and its interior open to show a sarcophagus inside, rusted iron railings and a sagging gate, bare twisted trees, ground mist lying in the hollows, a freshly turned mound of dark earth with a spade left standing in it.
boundary: an old boundary wall of rough moss-grown stone, seen as the flat top of the wall with iron railings along it
